Part of the 18.2.0 release sweep, wave anchor #25807. This applies all 18 checklist-accuracy findings that Tier 1 record #25815 (`release-18.2.0-tier1`, at `6679644a`) logged against `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/attachments-storage.json`.

Only checklist text changes. 10 items each take one `revision` bump and one `history` row. Each row cites #25815 and the finding. There is no product code, test, pin, `RUNNER.md` or changeset change. `attachments-storage.field-accept-maxsize-server-enforced` is untouched.

- Base `f6c61932`. The file has had no commit on `main` since the card was filed (last change `0f1eeeee`, 2026-10-22). Every pin named below was re-read on `main`. None of the read paths changed between `9753d163` and `f6c61932`.
- A scripted span editor made every edit and never re-serialises the file. It re-parses the result and asserts three things: the new document equals the old one with the declared ops applied; each changed item has revision +1 and exactly one appended row; and the 1 item it did not touch is byte-identical.
- All 18 lines were stale text. None describes a product defect, so no card is owed.

## How RUNNER rule 6 was applied

A pin scores only the layer it drives. Each edit names the layer from the pin's own harness: route-handler unit (a registered `RouteHandler` with a hand-built request and response, or a mock HTTP server), engine (ObjectQL in-process), or HTTP (a booted stack). Where a pin stops above a clause's oracle layer, the item now says the pin scores that clause `partial` and names the leg to drive by hand. Where a ref claimed a whole item, it is scoped per clause.

## Retired objectui pin wording

#26035 left the retired pin wording in the area JSON to these cards. This file has no hits for `objectui:(build|refresh|bump|clean)`, `build-console.sh`, `.objectui-sha` or `objectuiPin`, either before or after this change. Pin-era statements in two items this PR edits are corrected.

- `download-authz-both-sides`: the ref said "a console bundle this repo does not build". It now says the console is built from `ui/` by `pnpm console:build` into the gitignored `packages/console/dist`. `source[3]`'s `objectui packages/app-shell/...` path now reads `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordAttachmentsPanel.tsx`.
- `inline-grid-receipt-cells`: `knownGaps[0]` said "AUTOMATION IS PINNED IN THE objectui REPO, NOT HERE", with the spec runnable only "in an objectui checkout". Since the objectui import, the spec is `ui/e2e/live/grid-file-upload.spec.ts` in this tree. `automated.ref` and `source[1]` now name that path. `knownGaps[0]` now says how to run it from `ui/` (`pnpm test:e2e:live`, with a backend on port 3000 and the console dev server on port 5180), and it keeps the rule that an unrun pin is a claim, not evidence. This change rides on the item's one revision bump, and its history row says so. Earlier history rows are records and are left as written.

## Acceptance notes

- `RUNNER.md`'s standing fact on objectui-pinned automation ("Some items carry an `automated.ref` that lives ENTIRELY in the `objectui` repo") still says this repository holds none of those specs and builds no console bundle. Both are stale since the objectui import. By that entry's own rule, `inline-grid-receipt-cells` has now left the set, because its ref names a path that exists here. `RUNNER.md` is outside this card's file surface. #26101 kept its own items' objectui-only framing in step with that entry, so the two cards now differ on this point. Carrier: the devx seat (#25850 / #26035).
